tips: Bedtime: tap your bunk from 20:00 to sleep. You pick when your alarm wakes you (06:00 unless you change it), and a night's sleep fills your energy. Before 20:00
Fresh clothes are in your wardrobe: change each morning. When you run out, do your laundry on Deck 4.
The Schedule tracker, the target button under your needs, lists what's on now and next, and a few places. Tap one for an arrow; tap it again to stop.
Deck 3 is the Commons: the mess, the gym, the crew store, the call-home booths, the bow lounge and the promenade.
Take jobs here, and turn them in here when they're done.
Clock in by the tea corner at shift start, out at the end. Leave and sick days need none.
Track it on your device; the marker shows the way.
Tap the machine to inspect. You may need parts from storage or the machine shop.
While a long job's bar fills, you can open your device: check your Schedule, Mail or Schedule tracker. The work carries on.
Head back to the board to turn it in.
Not just jobs: kindness and joining in count too. Each department has its own view of you, and so does the ship.
Seven decks, one lift. Maps on your device shows where you are and what's on every deck.
Deck 5 is Operations: the Works bay and its job board, main storage and the machine shop. You work here.
Credits! Spend them at the crew store on Deck 3: snacks and small comforts. Some make good gifts.
Tap the beam to paint your name. The Works crew are waiting to see it go up.
Off shift. Your evening is yours: call home from the booths on Deck 3, go to a ship tradition (Calendar), talk a while with someone, or try a hobby.
Tap someone and choose Talk a while: a proper chat builds far more friendship than a quick hello.
You're getting to know someone. Chats, meals and favours move you along: stranger, acquaintance, colleague, friend, close friend.
Your device: Schedule and Calendar for your day, Maps to find your way, Jobs to track your work, Mail and Memos, Needs for how you feel.
Clean clothes come from your wardrobe. When they run out, take your hamper to the laundry on Deck 4: load a washer, and come back when it's done.
Clock in first: the time clock's in the Works bay, by the tea corner. Your shift starts at 09:00; Tracked shows you the way.
New mail. Read it in Mail on your device. Ship traditions are announced the evening before.
No clean clothes left. Take your hamper to the laundry on Deck 4.
Your first rounds are on the job board: five quick checks. Take the job, then follow the arrow.
You're at the fire point by the lift. Have a good look, and read what you see.
Everything as it should be? Tick it off.
You're at Cart dock 1. Have a good look, and read what you see.
On to the next check. Follow the arrow.
You're at the time clock. Have a good look, and read what you see.
On to the next check. Follow the arrow.
You're at Light relays 1. Have a good look, and read what you see.
Everything as it should be? Tick it off.
You're at the music room door. Have a good look, and read what you see.
That's the tour. Hand it in at the job board.
Heads-ups tell you what's coming. Set how early, or turn them off, in your device's Settings.
One call home a day: the relay gives everyone aboard one call each ship day. The booths are yours again tomorrow.
Slept well? Your bunk takes you from 20:00 through to 06:00. By day, lie on it to rest.
Hobbies fill your Leisure. Open Hobbies on your device to read, write, play a game or watch a film, anywhere you sit or stand still.
There's a ship tradition today. Turn up and join in. It's how the crew makes a long voyage feel like home.
Tap Tove to pick fruit. Anyone already taking part can bring you in, too.
The garden's yours off shift too. Tending a bed counts as a hobby: it fills your leisure.
Clock in first: the time clock's in the Works bay, by the tea corner. Your shift starts at 09:00; Tracked shows you the way.
Your needs sit in the strip at the top. Keep them up and the day goes well. Let them drop and you slow down.
No clean clothes left. Take your hamper to the laundry on Deck 4.
Parts in hand. Fit them at the job's machine. Spares go back to main storage.
Stay near while Yara works: your turn comes next.
Public washrooms are in the junior wing on Deck 4, and on Deck 3. Cabin bathrooms are private.
Several traditions on tonight, and you can't go to them all. Pick one in the Calendar.
Tired? Sit down anywhere for a bit; it slows the tiredness. Lying on your bunk rests you properly.
Getting late. Your bunk's in Bunk 1 on Deck 4. Stay up if you like. You'll feel it tomorrow.
